name: docs init and YAML feature store
description:
RepoDocsCli scaffold on RepoCli.Core: .repo-docs/ with repo.yaml, one {feature}.yaml per feature, config.yaml, .gitignore for the lock.
YamlDotNet; tool owns formatting (comments not preserved). git add / git mv like issues; lock for concurrent writes. init prefills a feature per Features/{X}/ with when.paths.
